text:
harper.marketing: quick idea after the webinar spike — combine prefetch with randomized backoff + ownership-affinity fallback to avoid RR skew. want a small canary.

tony-sdr: random backoff? hoping we don't make reps wait longer. last time we had people losing deals because fields appeared late.

harper.marketing: backoff only applies to re-evaluation, not initial assignment. flow: 1) on lead create trigger async enrich -> write temp props; 2) if temp props arrive <2s mark prefix; 3) claim logic prefers prefetched leads for 25s; 4) if RR imbalance detected fallback to ownership-affinity routing (sticky owner) for the cohort.

anya-salesops: Ownership-affinity fallback sounds risky. how do we measure "imbalance" and which owners?

harper.marketing: threshold: if rr_fairness_score worsens by >8% or any owner sees >20% claim spike over baseline in 5m window, enable affinity fallback for that cohort for 10m. affinity picks last-touch owner or owner_by_region.

hs-sync-bot: note: HS props to add: prefetch_state, prefetch_ts, temp_company, prefetch_score. SF mapping needs prefetch_state and prefetch_score.

lucas-ops: sample feature flag I can flip: ```json
{"flag":"routing.prefetch_backoff.v1","canary_pct":2,"enrich_wait_ms":2000,"prefer_window_ms":25000,"re_eval_backoff_max_ms":5000,"rr_fairness_threshold_pct":8,"owner_fallback_minutes":10}
```

michael-growth: cohort for canary: campaign=webinar_followup + leadscore>65. start 2% then 12% if stable. run for 48h and capture rep feedback.

tony-sdr: if affinity fallback kicks in will that hold leads for the same rep even if they were away? last time someone got flooded.

harper.marketing: fallback respects rep availability: only sticky if owner is active within last 24h; otherwise we route back to RR. also add a max-sticky cap per owner.

anya-salesops: we need a clear doc for reps: how to tell temp vs canonical fields, where to promote, and what to do if data conflicts. i'll draft one-pager.

lucas-ops: metrics i'll add to handoff dashboard: prefetch_attempt_rate, prefetch_success_before_claim_pct, rr_fairness_score, owner_claim_spike_pct, claim_latency_p95_ms, manual_promote_rate. auto-rollback if rr_fairness_score degrades >8% or claim_latency_p95 increases >20%.

hs-sync-bot: feature flag created: routing.prefetch_backoff.v1 (staging). remember to update webhook schema: include prefetch_state and temp_property list.

michael-growth: communication plan: short Slack blurb + one-pager in #sales, live demo at the weekly SDR huddle.

lucas-ops: pushing a 2% canary to prod at 7pm PT. smoke checks at +5m, +30m, +2h. i'll post updates in #handoff-sla.

ton y-sdr: (typo above) i'll collect rep notes during canary and surface any confusion.

harper.marketing: thanks all — check-in Fri 10am PT to decide widen/rollback. :rocket:
